title: Tracheostomy care

sources.use: AARC CPG on tracheostomy in the acute care setting (2021): identified, not read; cite-only
Open RN Nursing Skills (CC BY): publisher page returned 403 to the research tool

objectives: Know where authoritative tracheostomy guidance sits and that no content is yet drafted.

items.text: Tracheostomy care, inner-cannula care, tube changes and emergencies follow the unit's approved procedure and the surgical/respiratory team's instructions. No source for the steps has been read.

checklist.text: Confirm the tube type and the unit's emergency equipment arrangement before any care.
Call for help immediately for any airway emergency per unit protocol.
Record care given and the patient's response per unit standard.

gaps: Entire clinical content: the AARC 2021 guideline and Open RN Nursing Skills were not readable in Phase 7. No bedside procedure was written.
Emergency management (dislodged or blocked tube): needs a licensed, reviewed source.
permissions: AARC CPG: permission required for reproduction.
Open RN (CC BY): reuse with attribution once text can be read and image licences checked.
